newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's BNL 1996 cons profit up 35.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's BNL 1996 cons profit up 35.6 pct.

text.p: Italy's Banca Nazionale del Lavoro said it posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 151 billion lire, up 35.6 percent on 1995's 112 billion.
The bank said in a statement net profit before special items rose 35.7 percent to 918 billion lire while group assets rose to 11.757 trillion lire from 9.898 trillion.
Total group deposits amounted to 141.915 trillion lire, a two percent rise, of which 94.683 trillion were client deposits.
Total credits were 131.567 trillion lire, up 1.7 percent, of which 104.051 trillion were client loans.
BNL Chairman Mario Sarcinelli said in the statement that its alliance with insurer INA and the acquisition of the Banco di Napoli would "mark a historic turning point in the life of the group."
